pageCatalog.purpose: Complete searchable catalog of current public HTML surfaces across the connected Verve N Veda ecosystem.

policy.include: Public GitHub-facing HTML pages and current public learning/resource surfaces.
exclude: backup and dormant STOS migration surfaces
legacy/compatibility aliases excluded by catalog policy
policy.note: STOS remains dormant future-migration infrastructure; GitHub is the current functional public environment. New repositories remain under review until explicitly approved in the canonical master directory.

developmentStatusPurpose: Tracks implementation maturity separately from routing availability. The existing status field remains authoritative for public routing and visibility.

diplomacy.label: World & Diplomacy
diplomacy.purpose: Source-led country and cultural gateways that connect public history, heritage, language, civic understanding, and Khaemenes Academy learning.
diplomacy.publishingRule: Country gateways remain under review until explicitly approved here; active entries must use source-led factual presentation and maintain a visible education pathway.

searchMetadata.descriptionPolicy: Exact normalized URL matches only; mentor descriptions are historical source metadata, fallback descriptions are presentation metadata, derived descriptions identify title/type/category only. No maturity inferred from route status.
searchMetadata.developmentPolicy: Unassessed means implementation maturity not yet independently reviewed.
